software_class: content production, review, versioning, and publishing workspace

options.name: Editorial workspace
options.when_to_use: Humans review and shape generated content before publishing.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when only one-off generation is needed.
options.tradeoffs: Requires UX for drafts and reviews.
options.risks: Too much workflow can slow creation.

options.name: Batch generation pipeline
options.when_to_use: Large sets of content need repeatable production.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when each item needs bespoke editing.

options.name: Template-assisted studio
options.when_to_use: Content follows repeatable structures with controlled variation.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when originality and exploration dominate.
